# betterado_extension (Resource)

Manages an Azure DevOps Extension installation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betterado_extension" "example" {
  publisher_id = "ms-securitydevops"
  extension_id = "microsoft-security-devops-azdevops"
  disabled     = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `extension_id` (String) The Azure DevOps Marketplace extension identifier, for example `vss-code-search`.
- `publisher_id` (String) The Azure DevOps Marketplace publisher identifier, for example `ms`.

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the extension is disabled. Defaults to false when not set.
- `version` (String) The version of the extension to install. If not specified, the latest version is installed.

### Read-Only

- `extension_name` (String) The display name of the extension.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource (publisher_id/extension_id).
- `publisher_name` (String) The display name of the publisher.
- `scope` (List of String) The list of OAuth scopes required by the extension.
